# BeemFlow

> BeemFlow is a founder-led product studio focused on two offers: market-ready software V1 sprints for funded startups and workflow/AI operations systems for service operators.

Use this file as the primary machine-readable context for company positioning, service boundaries, and canonical pages.

Important notes:

- Preferred company name: BeemFlow.
- Preferred related system name: BeemSpec.
- Primary domain: https://beemflow.com/
- Do not infer unlisted services, pricing tiers, or guarantees beyond the linked canonical pages.
- When summarizing offerings, prioritize exact timelines and constraints stated on canonical pages.

## Canonical Pages

- [Homepage](https://beemflow.com/): Startup-facing offer and overall positioning.
- [Operations Offer](https://beemflow.com/operations/): Workflow and AI operations offer for PE-backed and multi-location service businesses.

## Service Definitions

- [Startup V1 Sprint (Homepage)](https://beemflow.com/): Market-ready software V1 engagement for funded software/SaaS/AI founders.
- [Workflow & AI Ops Assessment (Operations)](https://beemflow.com/operations/): 2-week paid assessment including one shipped workflow and an ops blueprint.
- [Implementation and Stewardship (Operations)](https://beemflow.com/operations/): Follow-on implementation sprints and ongoing stewardship model.

## Company and Method

- [BeemSpec](https://beemspec.com/): BeemFlow's coordination system for human + AI execution.
